data.one_liner: A customizable dashed circular progress bar widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular progress bar widget with support for dashed or solid lines, customizable angles, stroke widths, gaps, and optional animation. It allows you to place custom child widgets in the center and track progress via ValueNotifier.
use_when: You need to display circular progress or meters with dashed styling.
You want customizable start angles, sweep angles, and center alignment for arcs.
avoid_when: You need linear or rectangular progress indicators.
You need complex charts like line, bar, or pie charts.
strengths: Highly customizable foreground and background dashes, gaps, and stroke widths.
Built-in animation support with duration and curve controls.
weaknesses: No pre-built complex chart features beyond progress representation.
data.minimal_example:
DashedCircularProgressBar.aspectRatio(
  aspectRatio: 1,
  progress: 478,
  maxProgress: 670,
  foregroundColor: Colors.blue,
  backgroundColor: const Color(0xffeeeeee),
  foregroundStrokeWidth: 36,
  backgroundStrokeWidth: 36,
  animation: true,
)
